profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Creating High Quality Code for 25 Years
profile.summary: Senior backend engineer with 20+ years designing scalable systems and optimizing performance in production environments. Specializes in system architecture, performance tuning, and building developer tools that enhance team productivity. Thrives in collaborative environments where deep technical expertise and long-term ownership drive meaningful impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: American Fork, Utah, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Extended existing framework to implement new features,  including new API capabilities, new system behaviors, and performance enhancements.
* Developed supporting architecture for their integration into the larger Unanet ecosystem, as the business worked to integrate multiple systems into a cohesive offering for customers.
* Built a test data generator to create production-scale datasets (tens of thousands of orders, hundreds of thousands of inventory transactions), enabling performance validation and testing that was previously only possible in live environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: American Fork, Utah, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Worked with the product team to develop an automated scheduling system for short term contract employees, assigning them to positions based on a complex set of legal and logistical restrictions,  documented that system, and then trained the in-house developers on how it worked, so that they could handle the maintenance.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe ColdFusion · Troubleshooting · Software Design · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: My initial project was assisting in upgrading the team silo from PHP 7.4 to 8.1, ensuring that all deprecated code usage had been removed, and that no new bugs had been created during that migration process. Following that project, I worked on several performance optimization projects, and improved the throughput of their message queue by 10-20%, significantly reducing processing slowdowns at peak times.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · RabbitMQ · Docker · Migration Projects · Troubleshooting · Microservices · PHPUnit · MySQL · CI · Git · Back-End Web Development

positions.locationName: American Fork, Utah, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Backend
positions.description: As a Software Engineer II at BambooHR, I was a backend developer responsible for developing a modern reporting framework and implementing the company's culture survey products. I leveraged my expertise in PHP, MySQL, and PHPUnit to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality software products. Additionally, I used Docker for containerization and Git for version control to ensure seamless collaboration with cross-functional teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Backend
positions.description: Skills: PHP · Docker · Vagrant (Software) · Troubleshooting · PHPUnit · MySQL · CI · Git · GitHub · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As the Software Engineer at Graystone Media, I was responsible for developing and maintaining the website building platform and billing system. Leveraging my expertise in CakePHP, I ensured the timely delivery of high-quality software products while continuously improving the platform's performance and user experience. Additionally, I managed the server infrastructure, ensuring that it was optimized for performance, security, and scalability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained custom eCommerce shopping cart, that hosted multiple merchants, and handled fulfillment. System was written from scratch in a custom in-house PHP framework developed by myself.

I also managed system administration duties, including a backup solution that allowed rapid recovery from a near-total failure of the primary hosting hardware.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Linux System Administration · Troubleshooting · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · MySQL · Software Design · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained a hosting shopping cart solution for small businesses. Shopping cart systems were written in a mix of Perl and PHP. One of my primary responsibilities was developing the payment gateway integrations.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Migration Projects · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Perl · MySQL · Back-End Web Development

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped organize the Utah regions for National Novel Writing Month, including coordinating and maintaining the online chatrooms used by other MLs all over the world. My responsibilities included organizing meetups and events for local writers, and handling an online community for those who couldn't make it to my local events.
I fundraise for CMN through the Extra Life organization, and have raised an average of $1000+ per year since starting.

projects.title: Crystal Void
projects.description: Crystal Void is a 2D twin-stick shooter game that I am creating, heavily inspired by the classic shareware title Crystal Quest. It started as a Unity game, but following their license changes, I have been porting it over to the Godot game engine.

projects.title: Factorio Mod Developer
projects.description: In my free time, I enjoy playing and creating mods for Factorio.
